caption: Overlap lengths between simulated error-free reads of length 100. Blue: pairs whose real positions overlap by that many bases. Red: all other edges, which are chance matches or repeats. Dashed line: the minimum overlap tau chosen by the random-sequence bound. phiX174: 4509 true and 0.8 other edges per run; lambda: 38232 true and 1.6 other edges per run.
